reviews.author: Tyler delice

reviews.title: Great lavalier mic for a fair price
reviews.comment: I got this lavalier mic after my prior one started getting pops and crackles.  Had this since late 2019 and it has far outlasted my prior brand.  I have been using this with my old smart phone to capture audio for my YouTube videos.  Does a great job for a budget mic.  So if you can't bite the bullet and buy the more expensive audio options that run $100+, this is a great alternative to improve sound quality over built in mic setups on most camera's.  Keep in mind this will not be super high quality, but the wind socks this comes with do a much better job than I would have expected out of a $30 setup.  After several events and many trips packing and unpacking the sound quality still hasn't broken down or degraded.  I have definitely been impressed by the quality of sound you get for a ~$30 product.  The cord length is good, it comes with an extension cord, adapters and it also comes with 2 styles of windsock(the usual foamy style and a 'deadcat' style sock).  The wind socks do a pretty good job of getting rid of wind noise and other small background noises, but it's not perfect.  I use a standard plug on my phone, so haven't needed the adapters.  I would expect the adapters work, but I'll let someone who has used them comment on that part.  I can definitely say this was well worth the price and if I'm not ready to upgrade to a zoom setup by the time this dies, I would buy another.
reviews.author: woody

reviews.title: Worth buying
reviews.comment:
I used it in two ways: a. Directly connected to my DLSR camera. b. Connected to a portable recorder. For both I have more or less the same comments.
In general I am very satisfied by the result such a mic can give compared to its affordable price. Very good job!
I noticed that the final volume is a bit too loud if the mic is adjusted quite close to the chin. It must have a sufficient distance from the mouth to function better. Otherwise, either volume has to be adjusted later with software or you end up with an undesired result.
Some consonants sound well, the "S" for example, one of the most difficult, sounds very well but others like "P" and "B" are quite harsh and one has to try to make some adjustments -if possible- before starting recording.
Another plus point is that you don't get any "noise" from sounds around the source of sound. It can peak very easily only the sound of the person speaking and not other sounds around and it doesn't have any buzzle or noise created from the mic itself.
I also noticed that the low frequencies are a bit higher. Sometimes this is positive, it gives a nice deep color in the voice. But it's not as actual and as accurate as it should be to call it a convincing microphone.
As a conclusion I think there is space for improvement but if you compare the price with the quality of the product, then the result is superb. I recommend it unreservedly.

reviews.title: Excellent quality at a really great price.
reviews.comment:
The microphone stopped working after using it 2 times. I've tried connecting it to 3 different computers and 2 other recorders but it's dead.
I don't recommend this article to anyone. It's really BAD QUALITY!!!
Update: I reached out to the vendor to get my warranty and they shipped a brand new microphone within 2 days. It works like a charm. I've tested it on all my previous devices and there are no issues at all. The audio quality is really amazing.
